records.text: Carrie Prejean Boller has been removed from President Trump's Religious Liberty Commission.
records.speaker: Dan Patrick

appearances.snippet: Carrie Prejean Boller has been removed from President Trump (Donald J. Trump)'s Religious Liberty Commission.

verification.notes: Transcript context accurately quotes Dan Patrick's public announcement. AP reported the ouster and quoted the same statement; although Boller initially disputed Patrick's authority, a later White House personnel notice formally terminated her role, resolving the position.

records.text: Carrie Prejean Boller hijacked the commission's antisemitism hearing for her personal and political agenda, and removing her was my decision.
records.speaker: Dan Patrick

appearances.snippet: no member of the commission has the right to hijack a hearing for their own personal and political agenda on any issue. This is clearly without question what happened on Monday in our hearing on anti-Semitism in America. This was my decision.

verification.notes: Transcript context accurately reproduces Dan Patrick's public rationale. AP confirms he said she hijacked the hearing for a personal and political agenda and that removal was his decision. The DOJ transcript shows repeated intervention and Patrick limiting her questions, but 'hijacked' is Patrick's evaluative characterization rather than an independently provable fact.

records.text: Dan Patrick is purchased by Israel because he takes money from Zionists.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: you're taking a ton of money from Zionists. Can you just own that, Dan (Dan Patrick)? ... Own the fact that you, like everybody else, it's just outright purchased. You're outright purchased by Israel.

verification.notes: Transcript context is an accusation that campaign money proves Dan Patrick is 'purchased by Israel.' Live searches of official Texas campaign-finance resources and reporting show large donations and an Israel-bond investment by his committee, but no evidence that the State of Israel purchased or controlled Patrick. Donor identity or policy alignment alone cannot prove the asserted quid pro quo.
